newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Oct 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Oct 4.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Oct 4:

JERUSALEM - Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu returned triumphant from the Washington summit but disappointed Palestinians warned violence will explode again unless new talks produce swift and visible progress.
PHOENIX - Disappointment with presidential nominee Bob Dole has driven some registered Republicans away from their party.

WASHINGTON - Despite articles claiming that the CIA helped launch and played a major role in promoting the crack cocaine plague that swept America's inner cities in the 1980s, evidence of the alleged plot is lacking.

WASHINGTON - In the African-American community the alleged link between the CIA and crack hit a nerve, highlighting an inclination, born of bitter history, to accept as fact unsubstantiated reports about conspiracies targeting blacks.

WASHINGTON - Fairfax County executive William Leidinger is in danger of losing his job over his handling of a computer contract and his unwillingness to cut the bureaucracy in the Washington area's largest jurisdiction.

WASHINGTON - Two recent incidents involving a firstgrader and a seven-year-old boy planting kisses on the cheeks of classmates at school are stirring national debate on the issue of sexual harassment.
